description: Data for "Geospatial Mapping of Distribution Grid with Machine Learning and Publicly-Accessible Multi-Modal Data is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Zhecheng Wang. The data, ground truth labels, and model checkpoints are needed for the code repository: https://github.com/wangzhecheng/GridMapping. Unzip these zip files such that the directory structure looks like: GridMapping/checkpoint/... GridMapping/data/... GridMapping/results/... GridMapping/ground_truth/... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2158468587 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
